entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORDER 1. Heard on the question of admission.

2. The limited grievance raised in the instant petition by the petitioners is non-disposal of their representation (Annexure P/1) filed before the Collector, Gwalior on 29/08/2025 claiming compensation in lieu of his land affected by road widening bearing survey No.733/1023, area 0.520 hectare, situated in village Mehra (Morar), District Gwalior.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that without acquisition of the land widening of Sachin Tendulkar Marg (Gwalior) has been done on their land.
On their representation, Collector got enquiry conducted wherein this fact has been substantiated.

The petitioners by way of representation are seeking compensation of the land affected by the road widening on their land in terms of provisions enshrined under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:208 2 WP-48590-2025 2013.

sentences.text: He further submits that representation of petitioners is pending before the Collector, therefore, direction for its expeditious disposal may be issued.

4 . Looking to the limited prayer made by the petitioners, this writ petition is disposed of with direction that on petitioners furnishing certified copy of this order passed today along with copy of memo of writ petition along with relevant annexures in the office of the Collector within a period of two weeks from today, the Collector, District Gwalior shall make an endeavor to dispose of the pending representation of the petitioners as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of Ranjeet Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177746506/
1 90 days thereafter.
